prompt:
The section sections/social-feed-wall.liquid renders a social feed: a heading, a list of account handles joined with a merchant-chosen separator, and a list of posts whose hashtags are joined with ' · '. The markup is correct and must not change. Only the {% schema %} JSON is incomplete or wrong. Replace it so the schema is exactly the following (same keys, values and order).

Top-level keys, in order: "name": "Social feed", "tag": "section", "class": "social-feed-section", "settings", "blocks", "max_blocks": 12, "presets".

section settings, in this order:
1. type "text", id "heading", label "Heading", default "Follow us".
2. type "textarea", id "handles", label "Handles", info "Comma-separated". No default.
3. type "select", id "separator", label "Separator", options in order: {value " · " (space, middle dot U+00B7, space), label "Dot"}, {value " | ", label "Pipe"}, {value ", ", label "Comma"}; default " · ".
4. type "range", id "post_limit", label "Posts to show", min 2, max 12, step 1, default 6.

blocks: exactly one block definition: type "post", name "Post", settings in order: {type "text", id "caption", label "Caption"}, {type "text", id "tags", label "Tags"}, {type "url", id "link", label "Link"}. None of the block settings have defaults.

presets: exactly one preset with name "Social feed" and blocks [{"type": "post"}, {"type": "post"}].

Keep key order within each setting as: type, id, label, then info/options/min/max/step/default as applicable (options before default; min, max, step before default). Change only sections/social-feed-wall.liquid. Do not suppress checks or hardcode case values. All input keys are present.
